metadata.question: Did the volcanic plume from Nyamulagira at Virunga National Park drift eastward on February 20, 2025, captured by Landsat 8?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Landsat 8 SR (`LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2`) for 20 Feb 2025 over Nyamulagira summit (-1.408°S, 29.20°E) in Virunga. - Widen to ±2 days if no images exist (C1 recovery). 2. Masking: - Mask QA_PIXEL clouds & cloud-shadow bits (3,4,5) and keep only SWIR (B6) & Thermal (B10) which best highlight volcanic plumes. - Do NOT mask the plume itself – QA removes clouds, not ash/so2. 3. Plume detection logic: - SWIR reflectance (B6) in volcanic plumes is usually >0.05, and colder plume tops appear in B10 (DN to Kelvin). - Sample a 3-pixel radius around summit (plume core) and a 5-pixel-diameter circle 5 km eastward (downwind test). - Compute valid-pixel counts; if any are 0 → C2. - If both mean SWIR east > summit OR mean SWIR east > 0.05 and mean T east < mean T summit (evidence of drifting colder plume), label A; else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') pt = ee.Geometry.Point([29.20, -1.408]) # Nyamulagira summit date = '2025-02-20' start, end = ee.Date(date).advance(-2, 'day'), ee.Date(date).advance(2, 'day') col = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(pt) .filterDate(start, end) .sort('CLOUD_COVER')) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print('No Landsat 8 images') print('C1') exit() img = ee.Image(col.first()) def maskL8sr(i): qa = i.select('QA_PIXEL') cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4)).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5)) return i.updateMask(cloud.Not()) img = maskL8sr(img) core = pt.buffer(90) # ~3 pixels east = pt.buffer(90).transform('EPSG:4326').translate(0.05, 0) # ~5 km E swir = img.select('SR_B6') temp = img.select('ST_B10').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0) # to Kelvin def getMean(band, geom): res = band.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) return res.get(band.bandNames().get(0)).getInfo() def getCount(band, geom): return (band.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get(band.bandNames().get(0)).getInfo()) sc = getCount(swir, core) if sc == 0 or getCount(swir, east) == 0: print('No valid pixels after masking') print('C2') exit() mc = getMean(swir, core) me = getMean(swir, east) tc = getMean(temp, core) te = getMean(temp, east) print(f'SWIR core: {mc:.3f} east: {me:.3f}') print(f'Temp (K) core: {tc:.1f} east: {te:.1f}') print(f'Pixels core/east: {sc}/{getCount(swir,east)}') if me is None or te is None or tc is None or mc is None: print('C3') elif me > mc and te < tc and me > 0.05: # warmer SWIR & colder T east print('A') else: print('B') ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

pt = ee.Geometry.Point([29.20, -1.408])           # Nyamulagira summit
date = '2025-02-20'
start, end = ee.Date(date).advance(-2, 'day'), ee.Date(date).advance(2, 'day')

col = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
         .filterBounds(pt)
         .filterDate(start, end)
         .sort('CLOUD_COVER'))
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print('No Landsat 8 images')
    print('<answer>C1</answer>')
    exit()

img = ee.Image(col.first())
def maskL8sr(i):
  qa = i.select('QA_PIXEL')
  cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4)).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5))
  return i.updateMask(cloud.Not())
img = maskL8sr(img)

core = pt.buffer(90)                                # ~3 pixels
east = pt.buffer(90).transform('EPSG:4326').translate(0.05, 0)  # ~5 km E

swir = img.select('SR_B6')
temp = img.select('ST_B10').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0)  # to Kelvin

def getMean(band, geom):
  res = band.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                          geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
  return res.get(band.bandNames().get(0)).getInfo()
def getCount(band, geom):
  return (band.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                            geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
          .get(band.bandNames().get(0)).getInfo())

sc = getCount(swir, core)
if sc == 0 or getCount(swir, east) == 0:
    print('No valid pixels after masking')
    print('<answer>C2</answer>')
    exit()

mc = getMean(swir, core)
me = getMean(swir, east)
tc = getMean(temp, core)
te = getMean(temp, east)

print(f'SWIR core: {mc:.3f}  east: {me:.3f}')
print(f'Temp (K) core: {tc:.1f}  east: {te:.1f}')
print(f'Pixels core/east: {sc}/{getCount(swir,east)}')

if me is None or te is None or tc is None or mc is None:
    print('<answer>C3</answer>')
elif me > mc and te < tc and me > 0.05:            # warmer SWIR & colder T east
    print('<answer>A</answer>')
else:
    print('<answer>B</answer>')
